title: rfid
summary: NFC/UHF tag reader, dumper, emulator with tool suite
description: A full-featured RFID toolkit for CardputerZero. Connect via NFC Unit (I2C), PN532/PN532Killer (UART), or UHF Reader (UART) to read, dump, and emulate a wide range of tag types including NTAG21x, MIFARE Classic/Ultralight, ISO15693, FeliCa, and ISO14443B. Built-in tools: mfkey32/mfkey64 for MFC key recovery, hex log viewer, and slot-based profile management for rapid emulation switching.
